Altfest L J & Company Has Cut Apple Computer (AAPL) Holding by $1.17 Million; Shares Rose; Epoch Investment Partners Increased Icici Bk LTD (IBN) Stake by $3.94 Million; Stock Rose 
January 14, 2018 - By Nellie Frank 
Altfest L J & Company Inc decreased its stake in Apple Computer (AAPL) by 24.47% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Altfest L J & Company Inc sold 7,605 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.78% with the market. The institutional investor held 23,477 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $3.62M, down from 31,082 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Altfest L J & Company Inc who had been investing in Apple Computer for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $900.87 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.03% or $1.81 during the last trading session, reaching $177.09. About 25.42 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48% since January 14, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500. 
Epoch Investment Partners Inc increased its stake in Icici Bk Ltd (IBN) by 20.6% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC.
